coverage.reason: Covers pre-appointment checks, a written agreement, and ongoing monitoring, but does not say the ManCo must challenge delegate reports.
States delegation does not affect liability and says the ManCo must not become a letter-box entity.
Mentions designated persons overseeing investment management and administration and escalating issues, but not monitoring all six functions.

local_error: “The CBI must clear the investment manager in advance” — the supplied evidence says an EU-regulated firm only notifies, so this overstates the approval requirement.
rationale: Both required points receive substantive coverage, but point 1 omits the duty to challenge delegate reports. The inaccurate blanket approval claim is a material local falsehood and caps the grade at partial.
